messages:
Alex: Morning — quick check about next week's oncall handoff. I'm going to swap Tue night with Mira. Need a scribe for the 9:15 triage call and an escalation liaison for any P1s. Agenda I'm proposing:
```
- quick round: open incidents (live)
- ownership: who owns follow-ups
- escalations: current oncall liaisons
- action items + next handoff notes
```
Can @Mira or @Sam take scribe/liaison? Also thinking of switching to 15-min strict cadence for Tue/Thu.
Mira: I can take scribe Tue night, but need a hand for the first 10 mins to summarize alerts. :raised_hands:
Sam: I can be escalation liaison Tue night. If we get P1s, I'll grab page. Do we have runbook links in the agenda?
Alex: yep — adding runbook links. Also adding a short RC check for our Redis cluster.
oncall-bot: Incident summary: 2 open incidents (P2 redis-cache, P3 model-deploy), 0 P1s. Current latency spike cleared. https://incidents.internal/2005
Mira: I added quick notes to the agenda doc: https://docs.internal/shifts/2005 — put a short blurb under 'Redis' for context.
Jonah: Can we shorten agenda to essentials? Prefer: open incidents + ownership + rollout blockers. 15min max.
Alex: Sounds good. Final agenda updated, switching Tue/Thu to 15min. Scribe: Mira. Liaison: Sam. Anyone else need to swap shifts? If not, I'll update the calendar and handoff doc.
Sam: All good from me. I'll be reachable on pager and Slack.
Alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
